blocks.text: Washer & Dryer Removal FAQs

items.q: Do you remove both washers and dryers together?
a: Yes, we remove both appliances simultaneously. Our team efficiently handles complete laundry set removals, including stacked units, saving you time and hassle with a single service call.

items.q: Will you disconnect my washer and dryer before taking them?
a: Absolutely. Our technicians do not disconnect all water lines, drain hoses, gas lines (for dryers), and electrical connections following safety protocols before removal.

items.q: How much does washer and dryer removal cost?
a: Removal costs vary by unit type/size, but we provide free upfront quotes. Typically, removing both appliances together offers better value than separate removals.

items.q: What areas do you serve for appliance removal?
a: We service all Greater Toronto Area neighborhoods, including Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, and surrounding areas. No location in the Greater Toronto Area is too far.

items.q: Can I schedule a same-day pickup?
a: Yes, we often accommodate same-day requests when you call early. Our flexible scheduling can typically arrange removal within hours for urgent needs.

items.q: Do you recycle or donate old washers and dryers?
a: We prioritize recycling all components and donate working units to charities. Over 90% of materials are diverted from landfills through our eco-process.

items.q: Do I need to clean my washer and dryer before removal?
a: Just empty them. We handle all cleaning/disinfection after removal. For washers, we recommend running a drain cycle beforehand to remove excess water.

items.q: Will you remove stacked or built-in units?
a: Yes. Our experts safely dismantle and remove stacked laundry centers and built-in units without damaging surrounding cabinetry or walls.
